snippet.title: Demon Tides: Console Announcement
snippet.description:
Demon Tides will launch on the Switch, Switch 2 and PS5 on January 21st 2027!

Demon Tides had a critically acclaimed PC launch with a 95% Overwhelmingly Positive rating on Steam, 84 on metacritic and 86 on opencritic.

To learn more about Demon Tides, check out our website:
https://www.fabraz.com/#tides
